```{r}
##Starting with DeQueen.nutrient_dry, we will convert dry nutrient values to metric (lbs/US ton to kg/metric ton)

## Convert original (already dry-basis) nutrient values to metric
## lbs/US ton -> kg/metric ton (× 0.5)
## Overwrites the incorrectly moisture-corrected .dry columns

nutr_cols <- c("Nitrogen", "Ammonium.N", "Phosphorus", "Potassium")

DeQueen.nutrient_metric <- DeQueen.nutrient_dry %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(nutr_cols),
      ~ .x * 0.5,
      .names = "{.col}.dry"
    ),
    NH4_to_TotalN = Ammonium.N.dry / Nitrogen.dry
  )

## Quick sanity check
cat("\n=== Original values (lbs/US ton, already dry basis) ===\n")
dplyr::select(DeQueen.nutrient_dry,
              Sample.Name, Nitrogen, Ammonium.N) %>%
  head() %>%
  print()

cat("\n=== Metric conversion (kg/metric ton) ===\n")
dplyr::select(DeQueen.nutrient_metric,
              Sample.Name, Nitrogen, Nitrogen.dry, Ammonium.N, Ammonium.N.dry, NH4_to_TotalN) %>%
  head() %>%
  print()

## ----------------------------
## Long-format (metric) with clean labels & order
## ----------------------------

metric_cols_metric <- c(
  "Ammonium.N.dry", "Nitrogen.dry", "Phosphorus.dry", "Potassium.dry",
  "Moisture", "NH4_to_TotalN"
)

Nutrient_long.metric <- DeQueen.nutrient_metric %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(metric_cols_metric),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Level"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout   = factor(as.character(Growout), levels = c("Baseline", "1", "2")),
    Treatment = factor(as.character(Treatment)),
    Metric = dplyr::recode(
      Metric,
      Ammonium.N.dry = "NH4+ (kg/mt)",
      Nitrogen.dry   = "Total N (kg/mt)",
      Phosphorus.dry = "P (kg/mt)",
      Potassium.dry  = "K (kg/mt)",
      Moisture       = "Moisture (% wb)",
      NH4_to_TotalN  = "NH4+/Total N"
    ),
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c("NH4+ (kg/mt)", "Total N (kg/mt)", "NH4+/Total N",
                 "P (kg/mt)", "K (kg/mt)", "Moisture (% wb)")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Level), !is.na(Growout))

```

```{r}
## ================================================================
## Global model (METRIC): Growout + Treatment*Growout interaction included
## Re-uses your prior DRY workflow, but uses Nutrient_long.metric as input
## and writes NEW objects with .metric suffix (no overwrites).
## ================================================================

## --- Packages (assumed loaded elsewhere) -------------------------------------
# library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(tibble)
# library(MASS);  library(glmmTMB); library(DHARMa); library(emmeans); library(car)

## ================================================================
## Helpers (.metric)
## ================================================================
fmt_aics.metric <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  nms   <- names(x); if (is.null(nms)) nms <- rep("", length(x))
  if (any(is.na(x_num))) {
    paste(nms, as.character(x), sep = ":", collapse = "; ")
  } else {
    paste(nms, sprintf("%.1f", x_num), sep = ":", collapse = "; ")
  }
}

fit_dists_AIC.metric <- function(y) {
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]
  fits <- list()

  # normal on all finite values
  fits$normal <- tryCatch(MASS::fitdistr(y, "normal"), error = function(e) NULL)

  # gamma / lognormal on positive values only
  y_pos <- y[y > 0]
  fits$gamma <- if (length(y_pos) > 1) {
    tryCatch(MASS::fitdistr(y_pos, "gamma"), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL

  fits$lognorm <- if (length(y_pos) > 1) {
    tryCatch(MASS::fitdistr(y_pos, "lognormal"), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL

  aics <- c(
    normal  = if (!is.null(fits$normal))  AIC(fits$normal)  else NA_real_,
    gamma   = if (!is.null(fits$gamma))   AIC(fits$gamma)   else NA_real_,
    lognorm = if (!is.null(fits$lognorm)) AIC(fits$lognorm) else NA_real_
  )

  best <- names(which.min(aics))[1]
  list(aics = aics, best = best)
}

rbc_two_sample.metric <- function(x, y) {
  diffs <- outer(y, x, FUN = "-")
  mean(sign(diffs))
}

growout_levels.metric <- c("Baseline","1","2")

## ================================================================
## 0) Ensure clean factors (METRIC input)
##    NOTE: does NOT overwrite Nutrient_long.metric
## ================================================================
Nutrient_long.metric2 <- Nutrient_long.metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout   = factor(as.character(Growout), levels = growout_levels.metric),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment),
    Position  = factor(Position),
    House     = if ("House" %in% colnames(.)) factor(House) else factor(NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Level),
    !is.na(Growout),
    !is.na(Treatment)
  )

## ================================================================
## 1) BASELINE Wilcoxon: Treatment comparison within each Metric
## ================================================================
wilcox_baseline.metric <- Nutrient_long.metric2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Growout == "Baseline") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    df <- .x
    trts <- unique(df$Treatment)

    if (length(trts) != 2) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        Growout = "Baseline",
        group1  = NA_character_,
        group2  = NA_character_,
        n1      = NA_integer_,
        n2      = NA_integer_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        RBC     = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    # Try to keep Control vs Trt / IndigoLT if present
    if (all(c("Control","Trt") %in% levels(df$Treatment))) {
      g1 <- "Control"; g2 <- "Trt"
    } else if (all(c("Control","IndigoLT") %in% levels(df$Treatment))) {
      g1 <- "Control"; g2 <- "IndigoLT"
    } else {
      ord <- sort(as.character(trts))
      g1 <- ord[1]; g2 <- ord[2]
    }

    x <- df$Level[df$Treatment == g1]
    y <- df$Level[df$Treatment == g2]

    wt  <- suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    )
    RBC <- rbc_two_sample.metric(x, y)

    tibble::tibble(
      Growout = "Baseline",
      group1  = g1,
      group2  = g2,
      n1      = length(x),
      n2      = length(y),
      p.value = unname(wt$p.value),
      RBC     = RBC
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

## ================================================================
## 2) BEST DISTRIBUTION per Metric (Growouts 1 & 2 combined)
## ================================================================
dist_picker_global.metric <- Nutrient_long.metric2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Growout %in% c("1","2")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    .fits   = list(fit_dists_AIC.metric(Level)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_dist = purrr::map_chr(.fits, "best"),
    AICs      = purrr::map(.fits, "aics")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.fits)

dist_picker_out_global.metric <- dist_picker_global.metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(AICs_fmt = purrr::map_chr(AICs, fmt_aics.metric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Metric, best_dist, AICs_fmt)

print(dist_picker_out_global.metric, n = Inf)
utils::write.csv(
  dist_picker_out_global.metric,
  "nutrient_best_distributions_by_metric_global.METRIC.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

## ================================================================
## 3) Global GLMMs per Metric across Growouts 1 & 2
##    - lognorm: log(Level) ~ Gaussian
##    - gamma:   Gamma(link="log")
##    - normal:  Gaussian
##    - random: (1 | Growout:House), dropped if variance <= 1e-6
##    - fixed:  Treatment * Growout + Position
##    - emmeans: Treatment within Growout (BH-adjusted)
## ================================================================
.get_family.metric <- function(fam_name) {
  if (fam_name == "normal")  return(stats::gaussian(link = "identity"))
  if (fam_name == "gamma")   return(stats::Gamma(link = "log"))
  if (fam_name == "lognorm") return(stats::gaussian(link = "identity"))  # on log(Level)
  stop("Unsupported family: ", fam_name)
}

.extract_rand_var.metric <- function(model) {
  vc <- try(glmmTMB::VarCorr(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vc, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
  vcdf <- try(as.data.frame(vc), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vcdf, "try-error") || !nrow(vcdf)) return(NA_real_)
  row <- vcdf[vcdf$component == "cond" & grepl("Growout:House", vcdf$grp), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(row)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(row$sdcor[1])^2
}

fit_one_glmm_joint.metric <- function(metric,
                                      fam_name,
                                      var_thresh  = 1e-6,
                                      n_sims      = 1000,
                                      plot_dharma = FALSE) {

  df <- Nutrient_long.metric2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(Growout %in% c("1","2"), Metric == metric) %>%
    droplevels()

  # Make sure Growout, Treatment, Position, House are factors
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Growout   = factor(Growout, levels = c("1","2")),
      Treatment = factor(Treatment),
      Position  = factor(Position),
      House     = if ("House" %in% colnames(.)) factor(House) else factor(NA_character_)
    )

  # Response
  resp <- "Level"
  if (fam_name == "lognorm") {
    if (any(df$Level <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      stop("Metric '", metric, "' has non-positive values; cannot log-transform for lognormal.")
    }
    df$Level_log <- log(df$Level)
    resp <- "Level_log"
  }

  fam <- .get_family.metric(fam_name)

  # Sum-to-zero contrasts for Type III
  old_contr <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum","contr.poly"))

  # Random effect structure
  use_house <- ("House" %in% colnames(df)) && (nlevels(df$House) > 1)
  form_full <- if (use_house) {
    stats::as.formula(paste0(resp, " ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | Growout:House)"))
  } else {
    stats::as.formula(paste0(resp, " ~ Treatment * Growout + Position"))
  }

  mod <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(form_full, family = fam, data = df)

  # Drop random effect if variance ~ 0
  kept_random <- FALSE
  if (use_house) {
    rv <- .extract_rand_var.metric(mod)
    if (!is.na(rv) && rv > var_thresh) {
      kept_random <- TRUE
    } else {
      form_simpl <- stats::as.formula(paste0(resp, " ~ Treatment * Growout + Position"))
      mod <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(form_simpl, family = fam, data = df)
    }
  }

  # Type III tests
  a3 <- car::Anova(mod, type = 3)

  # emmeans: Treatment within Growout
  emm_by <- emmeans::emmeans(mod, ~ Treatment | Growout)
  pw     <- emmeans::contrast(emm_by, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
  pw_df  <- as.data.frame(summary(pw))

  # Identify CL columns (emmeans version-safe)
  lo <- dplyr::case_when(
    "lower.CL"  %in% names(pw_df) ~ "lower.CL",
    "asymp.LCL" %in% names(pw_df) ~ "asymp.LCL",
    "LCL"       %in% names(pw_df) ~ "LCL",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  hi <- dplyr::case_when(
    "upper.CL"  %in% names(pw_df) ~ "upper.CL",
    "asymp.UCL" %in% names(pw_df) ~ "asymp.UCL",
    "UCL"       %in% names(pw_df) ~ "UCL",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  if (fam_name %in% c("gamma","lognorm")) {
    # Ratios on response scale
    pw_df_out <- pw_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        estimate  = exp(estimate),
        lower.CL  = if (!is.na(lo)) exp(.data[[lo]]) else NA_real_,
        upper.CL  = if (!is.na(hi)) exp(.data[[hi]]) else NA_real_,
        df        = if ("df" %in% names(.)) df else NA_real_,
        effect_scale = ifelse(fam_name == "gamma",
                              "ratio_of_means",
                              "ratio_of_geometric_means")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Growout, contrast, estimate, SE, df,
                    lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value, effect_scale)
  } else {
    # Differences on response scale
    pw_df_out <- pw_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        lower.CL     = if (!is.na(lo)) .data[[lo]] else NA_real_,
        upper.CL     = if (!is.na(hi)) .data[[hi]] else NA_real_,
        df           = if ("df" %in% names(.)) df else NA_real_,
        effect_scale = "difference_in_means"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Growout, contrast, estimate, SE, df,
                    lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value, effect_scale)
  }

  # DHARMa
  simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod, n = n_sims)
  disp   <- DHARMa::testDispersion(simres)
  outs   <- DHARMa::testOutliers(simres)
  quants <- DHARMa::testQuantiles(simres)

  if (plot_dharma) {
    cat("\n--- DHARMa diagnostics (metric) ---\n")
    print(disp); print(outs); print(quants)
    plot(simres, main = paste("DHARMa residuals:", metric))
  }

  # Restore contrasts
  options(old_contr)

  list(
    metric       = metric,
    family_used  = fam_name,
    transform    = if (fam_name == "lognorm") "log" else "none",
    kept_random  = kept_random,
    model        = mod,
    anova3       = a3,
    emmeans      = emm_by,
    pairs_contr  = pw,
    pairs_df     = pw_df_out,
    dharma       = list(sim = simres,
                        dispersion = disp,
                        outliers   = outs,
                        quantiles  = quants)
  )
}

## ---- Fit all global models ----
nutrient_models_joint.metric <- purrr::pmap(
  list(
    metric   = dist_picker_global.metric$Metric,
    fam_name = dist_picker_global.metric$best_dist
  ),
  ~ fit_one_glmm_joint.metric(
    metric     = ..1,
    fam_name   = ..2,
    var_thresh = 1e-6,
    n_sims     = 1000,
    plot_dharma = FALSE
  )
)
names(nutrient_models_joint.metric) <- dist_picker_global.metric$Metric

## ================================================================
## 4) Collect GLMM outputs: ANOVA + emmeans contrasts
## ================================================================

# 4a) Pairwise Treatment contrasts within Growout (from emmeans)
nutrient_pairs_joint.metric <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(nutrient_models_joint.metric, function(x) {
    out <- x$pairs_df
    out$Metric <- x$metric
    out$family <- x$family_used
    out
  })
)
row.names(nutrient_pairs_joint.metric) <- NULL

# 4b) Type III ANOVA tables
nutrient_anova_joint_df.metric <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(nutrient_models_joint.metric, function(x) {
    a3 <- as.data.frame(x$anova3)
    a3$Term   <- rownames(a3)
    a3$Metric <- x$metric
    a3$family <- x$family_used
    rownames(a3) <- NULL
    a3[, c("Metric","family","Term", setdiff(names(a3), c("Metric","family","Term")))]
  })
)
row.names(nutrient_anova_joint_df.metric) <- NULL

## ================================================================
## 5) Combine Baseline Wilcoxon + GLMM contrasts and export
## ================================================================

baseline_brief.metric <- wilcox_baseline.metric %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Metric,
    Growout,
    method       = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
    contrast     = paste0(group2, " - ", group1),
    effect_scale = "rank-biserial",
    estimate     = RBC,
    lower.CL     = NA_real_,
    upper.CL     = NA_real_,
    p.value      = p.value
  )

glmm_brief.metric <- nutrient_pairs_joint.metric %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Metric,
    Growout,
    method       = paste0("GLMM (", family, "), Treatment within Growout"),
    contrast,
    effect_scale,
    estimate,
    lower.CL,
    upper.CL,
    p.value
  )

nutrient_results_all_global.metric <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  baseline_brief.metric,
  glmm_brief.metric
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Metric,
                 factor(Growout, levels = growout_levels.metric))

## ---- Console checks ----
print(nutrient_anova_joint_df.metric,     n = Inf)
print(nutrient_pairs_joint.metric,        n = Inf)
print(nutrient_results_all_global.metric, n = Inf)

## ---- Write to CSV ----
utils::write.csv(
  nutrient_anova_joint_df.metric,
  "nutrient_GLMM_TypeIII_global.METRIC.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  nutrient_pairs_joint.metric,
  "nutrient_GLMM_treatment_contrasts_global_byGrowout.METRIC.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  nutrient_results_all_global.metric,
  "nutrient_treatment_results_all_global.METRIC.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
##Visualization (METRIC) — MATCH TEMPLATE AESTHETICS EXACTLY
## Uses:
##   - Nutrient_long.metric2
##   - nutrient_results_all_global.metric
##   - predefined pal_fill, pal_color, dodge_width (do not redefine unless missing)

## =====================================================================
## 1) Build p-value labels for plotting from *metric* stats object
## =====================================================================
p_values_plot_df.metric <- nutrient_results_all_global.metric %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (Growout == "Baseline" & grepl("Wilcoxon", method)) |
      (Growout %in% c("1", "2") & grepl("^GLMM", method))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Growout) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%  # ensure single row per Metric × Growout
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric  = factor(Metric,  levels = levels(Nutrient_long.metric2$Metric)),
    Growout = factor(Growout, levels = levels(Nutrient_long.metric2$Growout)),
    P_Value = p.value,
    P_Label = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(P_Value),
      NA_character_,
      sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", P_Value)
    )
  )

## =====================================================================
## 2) y-positions just above the tallest point per Metric × Growout
## =====================================================================
y_pos_df.metric <- Nutrient_long.metric2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Growout) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y_pos = max(Level, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.03, .groups = "drop")

p_values_plot_df.metric <- dplyr::left_join(
  p_values_plot_df.metric, y_pos_df.metric,
  by = c("Metric","Growout")
)

## =====================================================================
## 3) Helper data for plot: stripe + mean lines
## =====================================================================
.g_levels.metric <- levels(Nutrient_long.metric2$Growout)
.idx1.metric <- which(.g_levels.metric == "1")

stripes_df.metric <- tibble::tibble(
  xmin = if (length(.idx1.metric)) .idx1.metric - 0.5 else NA_real_,
  xmax = if (length(.idx1.metric)) .idx1.metric + 0.5 else NA_real_
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(xmin), is.finite(xmax))

mean_levels_df.metric <- Nutrient_long.metric2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Growout, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_Level = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

## =====================================================================
## 4) Graphics params (use existing template palettes)
## =====================================================================
if (!exists("dodge_width")) dodge_width <- 0.6
if (!exists("pal_fill")) {
  trts <- levels(Nutrient_long.metric2$Treatment)
  pal_fill <- stats::setNames(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(trts)), "Set2")[seq_along(trts)],
    trts
  )
}
if (!exists("pal_color")) pal_color <- pal_fill

## =====================================================================
## 5) Plot — COPY TEMPLATE AESTHETICS EXACTLY
## =====================================================================
p.metric.horizontal <- ggplot(Nutrient_long.metric2, aes(x = Growout, y = Level)) +
  # Light stripe for Growout "1"
  { if (nrow(stripes_df.metric))
      geom_rect(
        data  = stripes_df.metric,
        aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill  = "gray85",
        alpha = 0.5
      )
    else
      NULL } +
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.9,
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  # Mean points
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size  = 3,
    color = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Jittered observations
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size  = 1.25,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill  = "white",
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.10,
      dodge.width  = dodge_width
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Treatment trendlines (means)
  geom_line(
    data = mean_levels_df.metric,
    aes(x = Growout, y = Mean_Level, group = Treatment, color = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
  # p-value labels (only where present)
  geom_text(
    data = p_values_plot_df.metric %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(P_Label)),
    aes(x = Growout, y = y_pos, label = P_Label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size  = 3,
    vjust = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_fill,  drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_color, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position  = "top"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Growout", fill = "Treatment", color = "Treatment")

print(p.metric.horizontal)

ggsave(
  "nutrients_box_with_pvals_metric.horizontal.png",
  p.metric.horizontal,
  width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 900
)
```

```{r}
##Get nutrient data into phyloseq (METRIC)

## ============================
## Get *metric* nutrient data into phyloseq (kg/metric ton)
## (Note: in DeQueen.nutrient_metric, the converted values live in the SAME
##        .dry column names, and the ratio column is still NH4_to_TotalN)
## ============================

# --- 1) Start from your existing phyloseq -------------------------------------
ps0.metric <- ps
sd0.metric <- as(sample_data(ps0.metric), "data.frame")
orig_sample_names.metric <- sample_names(ps0.metric)   # authoritative

# --- 2) Build a nutrient key (metric) with valid, non-baseline sample IDs -----
nutr_key.metric <- DeQueen.nutrient_metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Growout_chr = as.character(Growout)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("^\\s*baseline\\s*$", tolower(Growout_chr))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(.id_num = stringr::str_extract(as.character(Sample.Name), "\\d+")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.id_num)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample.ID = paste0("Sample_", .id_num)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample.ID %in% orig_sample_names.metric) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample.ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(c(
      "Sample.ID",
      "Nitrogen.dry",       # now kg/metric ton (because you multiplied by 0.5)
      "Ammonium.N.dry",     # kg/metric ton
      "Phosphorus.dry",     # kg/metric ton
      "Potassium.dry",      # kg/metric ton
      "Moisture",           # % wb
      "NH4_to_TotalN"       # recomputed from converted .dry cols
    ))
  )

# --- 3) Join nutrients (metric) into sample metadata, restore & order rownames --
sd_aug.metric <- sd0.metric %>%
  dplyr::left_join(nutr_key.metric, by = "Sample.ID")

rownames(sd_aug.metric) <- orig_sample_names.metric
sd_aug.metric <- sd_aug.metric[orig_sample_names.metric, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(sd_aug.metric), orig_sample_names.metric))

# --- 4) Wrap back into sample_data and rebuild phyloseq ------------------------
sd_aug_ps.metric <- sample_data(sd_aug.metric)

pieces.metric <- list(otu_table(ps0.metric), sd_aug_ps.metric)

tt.metric <- try(tax_table(ps0.metric, errorIfNULL = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
if (!inherits(tt.metric, "try-error") && !is.null(tt.metric)) pieces.metric <- c(pieces.metric, list(tt.metric))

tr.metric <- try(phy_tree(ps0.metric, errorIfNULL = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
if (!inherits(tr.metric, "try-error") && !is.null(tr.metric)) pieces.metric <- c(pieces.metric, list(tr.metric))

rs.metric <- try(refseq(ps0.metric, errorIfNULL = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
if (!inherits(rs.metric, "try-error") && !is.null(rs.metric)) pieces.metric <- c(pieces.metric, list(rs.metric))

physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric <- do.call(phyloseq, pieces.metric)

# Final verification
stopifnot(identical(sample_names(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric), orig_sample_names.metric))


```

```{r}
##Maaslin analysis (METRIC)
# ============================================================
# MaAsLin2: Species ~ Physicochemical variables (METRIC UNITS)
# USING: physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric
# NOTE: In your metric phyloseq, nutrient columns are still named
#       Nitrogen.dry, Ammonium.N.dry, Phosphorus.dry, Potassium.dry,
#       and NH4_to_TotalN (values are now kg/metric ton for the .dry cols)
# ============================================================

# ---------- 0) Features (rows) x Samples (cols) + metadata ----------
X.metric <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric))
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric)) {
  X.metric <- as.data.frame(t(X.metric))  # rows = species/features, cols = samples
}
meta.metric <- as(sample_data(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric), "data.frame")

# Align samples
common.metric <- intersect(colnames(X.metric), rownames(meta.metric))
if (length(common.metric) < 10) stop("Too few overlapping samples between features and metadata.")
X.metric    <- X.metric[, common.metric, drop = FALSE]
meta.metric <- meta.metric[common.metric, , drop = FALSE]

# Ensure numeric feature matrix
X.metric[] <- lapply(X.metric, function(v) as.numeric(v))

# Drop all-zero species
keep_feat.metric <- rowSums(X.metric) > 0
if (!all(keep_feat.metric)) {
  message("Dropping ", sum(!keep_feat.metric), " all-zero species.")
  X.metric <- X.metric[keep_feat.metric, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Rounded copy for exploratory NEGBIN/ZINB
X_round.metric <- X.metric
X_round.metric[] <- lapply(X_round.metric, function(v) as.numeric(round(v, 0)))

# ---------- 1) Variables ----------
# Use the same column NAMES (values are metric). Exclude ratio.
env_vars.metric <- intersect(
  c("Nitrogen.dry","Ammonium.N.dry","Phosphorus.dry","Potassium.dry","Moisture"),
  colnames(meta.metric)
)
if (length(env_vars.metric) == 0) {
  stop("None of the physicochemical variables are present in sample_data.")
}

covars.metric   <- intersect(c("Treatment","Growout","Position"), colnames(meta.metric))
rand_eff.metric <- intersect("House", colnames(meta.metric))  # optional random effect

# ---------- 2) Build Maaslin2 'reference' vector for categorical covariates ----------
build_reference_vec.metric <- function(meta_df, covariate_names) {
  ref <- character(0)
  for (v in covariate_names) {
    if (!v %in% colnames(meta_df)) next
    vals <- meta_df[[v]]
    levs <- sort(unique(as.character(vals)))
    if (length(levs) <= 1) next
    preferred <- switch(
      v,
      "Position"  = if ("A" %in% levs) "A" else levs[1],
      "Treatment" = if ("Control" %in% levs) "Control" else levs[1],
      "Growout"   = if ("1" %in% levs) "1" else if ("G1" %in% levs) "G1" else levs[1],
      levs[1]
    )
    ref <- c(ref, v, preferred)
  }
  ref
}

# ---------- 3) Helper to run MaAsLin2 ----------
run_maaslin2.metric <- function(Xmat, meta_df, outdir, analysis_method, fixed, random = NULL,
                                ref_vec = NULL,
                                normalization = "NONE", transform = "NONE",
                                min_prev = 0.25) {
  Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
    input_data       = Xmat,
    input_metadata   = meta_df,
    output           = outdir,
    fixed_effects    = fixed,
    random_effects   = random,
    reference        = ref_vec,
    normalization    = normalization,   # CSS already applied upstream
    transform        = transform,       # keep CSS scale
    analysis_method  = analysis_method, # "CPLM","LM","NEGBIN","ZINB"
    standardize      = TRUE,            # z-score continuous metadata
    min_prevalence   = min_prev,
    min_abundance    = 0.0,
    correction       = "BH",
    plot_heatmap     = FALSE,
    plot_scatter     = FALSE,
    cores            = 1
  )
}

# =========================
# 4) RUNS (METRIC)
# =========================

# --- Primary: CPLM on CSS (ENV-ONLY) ---
run_maaslin2.metric(
  X.metric, meta.metric,
  outdir  = "maaslin_env_only_cplm_metric",
  analysis_method = "CPLM",
  fixed   = env_vars.metric,
  random  = NULL,
  ref_vec = NULL
)

# --- Primary: CPLM on CSS (ENV + COVARIATES) ---
if (length(covars.metric) > 0) {
  ref_vec.metric <- build_reference_vec.metric(meta.metric, covars.metric)
  run_maaslin2.metric(
    X.metric, meta.metric,
    outdir  = "maaslin_env_covars_cplm_metric",
    analysis_method = "CPLM",
    fixed   = c(env_vars.metric, covars.metric),
    random  = if (length(rand_eff.metric) == 1) rand_eff.metric else NULL,
    ref_vec = ref_vec.metric
  )
}

# --- Sensitivity: LM on CSS (ENV-ONLY) ---
run_maaslin2.metric(
  X.metric, meta.metric,
  outdir  = "maaslin_env_only_lm_metric",
  analysis_method = "LM",
  fixed   = env_vars.metric,
  random  = NULL,
  ref_vec = NULL
)

# --- Sensitivity: LM on CSS (ENV + COVARIATES) ---
if (length(covars.metric) > 0) {
  ref_vec.metric <- build_reference_vec.metric(meta.metric, covars.metric)
  run_maaslin2.metric(
    X.metric, meta.metric,
    outdir  = "maaslin_env_covars_lm_metric",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    fixed   = c(env_vars.metric, covars.metric),
    random  = if (length(rand_eff.metric) == 1) rand_eff.metric else NULL,
    ref_vec = ref_vec.metric
  )
}

# --- Exploratory: NEGBIN/ZINB on *rounded* CSS (ENV-ONLY) ---
run_maaslin2.metric(
  X_round.metric, meta.metric,
  outdir  = "maaslin_env_only_negbin_roundedCSS_metric",
  analysis_method = "NEGBIN",
  fixed   = env_vars.metric,
  random  = NULL,
  ref_vec = NULL
)

run_maaslin2.metric(
  X_round.metric, meta.metric,
  outdir  = "maaslin_env_only_zinb_roundedCSS_metric",
  analysis_method = "ZINB",
  fixed   = env_vars.metric,
  random  = NULL,
  ref_vec = NULL
)

# --- Exploratory: NEGBIN/ZINB on *rounded* CSS (ENV + COVARIATES) ---
if (length(covars.metric) > 0) {
  ref_vec.metric <- build_reference_vec.metric(meta.metric, covars.metric)

  run_maaslin2.metric(
    X_round.metric, meta.metric,
    outdir  = "maaslin_env_covars_negbin_roundedCSS_metric",
    analysis_method = "NEGBIN",
    fixed   = c(env_vars.metric, covars.metric),
    random  = if (length(rand_eff.metric) == 1) rand_eff.metric else NULL,
    ref_vec = ref_vec.metric
  )

  run_maaslin2.metric(
    X_round.metric, meta.metric,
    outdir  = "maaslin_env_covars_zinb_roundedCSS_metric",
    analysis_method = "ZINB",
    fixed   = c(env_vars.metric, covars.metric),
    random  = if (length(rand_eff.metric) == 1) rand_eff.metric else NULL,
    ref_vec = ref_vec.metric
  )
}

message("MaAsLin2 (metric) runs complete. Check *_metric output folders for results.")
```

```{r}
##Maaslin summary for the manuscript
 ## ============================================================
## Summarize significant taxa–environment associations (UPDATED)
## Goal:
##   1) Per-metric counts (sig / pos / neg)
##   2) Top 3–5 taxa with most associations + details
##   3) Genus-level patterns WITHIN a single physicochemical metric:
##        -> Identify the strongest genus–metric "signals"
##           (many taxa within a genus associated with the same metric,
##            with directionality + top genera per metric)
## Outputs printed.
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

## ---- 0) Input checks & coercion ----
stopifnot(exists("mat_plot.metric"))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(mat_plot.metric)))

mat <- as.data.frame(mat_plot.metric)
mat[] <- lapply(mat, as.numeric)

env_metrics <- colnames(mat)
stopifnot(length(env_metrics) > 0)

cat("\n====================\n")
cat("Association matrix summary\n")
cat("====================\n")
cat("Taxa (rows):", nrow(mat), "\n")
cat("Env metrics (cols):", ncol(mat), "\n")
cat("Metrics:", paste(env_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")

## ---- 1) Per-metric summary (#sig, #pos, #neg) ----
per_metric_summary <- tibble(Metric = env_metrics) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_sig = sum(!is.na(mat[[Metric]])),
    n_pos = sum(mat[[Metric]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_neg = sum(mat[[Metric]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig))

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("1) Per-metric significant association counts\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(per_metric_summary)

## ---- 2) Convert to long format (non-NA only) ----
long_df <- mat %>%
  mutate(Taxon = rownames(mat)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(env_metrics),
    names_to = "EnvMetric",
    values_to = "Effect"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Effect)) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = ifelse(Effect > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    Genus = word(Taxon, 1)
  )

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("2) Long-format association table (first 10 rows)\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(head(long_df, 10))

## ---- 3) Top taxa with most associations (3–5) ----
top_n_taxa <- 5  # change to 3 if you want only top 3

taxon_assoc_counts <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    n_assoc = n(),
    n_pos = sum(Direction == "Positive"),
    n_neg = sum(Direction == "Negative"),
    signed_metrics = paste0(
      EnvMetric, "=", round(Effect, 3), " (", ifelse(Effect > 0, "+", "-"), ")"
    ) %>% paste(collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_assoc), desc(n_pos), Taxon)

top_taxa <- taxon_assoc_counts %>% slice(1:top_n_taxa)

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("3) Top taxa by number of significant associations (top", top_n_taxa, ")\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(top_taxa)

## Ready-to-write strings for the paragraph (per-metric + top taxa)
metric_sentence_bits <- per_metric_summary %>%
  mutate(summary = paste0(Metric, ": n=", n_sig, " (", n_pos, " positive; ", n_neg, " negative)")) %>%
  pull(summary)

top_taxa_sentence_bits <- top_taxa %>%
  mutate(summary = paste0(Taxon, " (", n_assoc, "): ", signed_metrics)) %>%
  pull(summary)

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("3b) Ready-to-write summary strings\n")
cat("====================\n")
cat("\nPer-metric:\n")
print(metric_sentence_bits)
cat("\nTop taxa:\n")
print(top_taxa_sentence_bits)

## ============================================================
## 4) Genus-level patterns within a single physicochemical metric
##    We want "substantial patterns" where:
##      - Many taxa within a genus associate with the same metric
##      - Directionality is coherent (mostly + or mostly -)
##    We'll compute:
##      A) Genus x Metric summary (# taxa, pos taxa, neg taxa, prop_pos)
##      B) Rank genus-metric pairs by a "signal score":
##           score = n_taxa * abs(prop_pos - 0.5) * 2
##           (increases with more taxa AND stronger directionality)
##      C) Return top 3 genus-metric pairs overall + top 3 per metric
## ============================================================

genus_metric <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Genus, EnvMetric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_taxa = n_distinct(Taxon),
    n_pos_taxa = n_distinct(Taxon[Direction == "Positive"]),
    n_neg_taxa = n_distinct(Taxon[Direction == "Negative"]),
    prop_pos = n_pos_taxa / n_taxa,
    dominant_dir = ifelse(prop_pos >= 0.5, "Positive", "Negative"),
    dominance = pmax(prop_pos, 1 - prop_pos),  # how one-sided the direction is
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # signal score: many taxa + strong one-sided directionality
    signal_score = n_taxa * (abs(prop_pos - 0.5) * 2),
    # a simple readable label
    summary = paste0(
      Genus, " ~ ", EnvMetric, ": n_taxa=", n_taxa,
      " (pos=", n_pos_taxa, "; neg=", n_neg_taxa, "; dominant=", dominant_dir,
      "; prop_pos=", round(prop_pos, 2), "; score=", round(signal_score, 2), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(signal_score), desc(n_taxa))

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("4) Genus x Metric summary (top 30 by signal_score)\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(genus_metric %>% slice(1:30))

## ---- Top 3 genus–metric "signals" overall ----
top3_genus_metric_overall <- genus_metric %>% slice(1:3)

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("4b) Top 3 genus–metric associations overall (strongest patterns)\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(top3_genus_metric_overall %>% select(Genus, EnvMetric, n_taxa, n_pos_taxa, n_neg_taxa, prop_pos, dominant_dir, signal_score))

cat("\n\nTop 3 genus–metric (ready-to-write):\n")
print(top3_genus_metric_overall$summary)

## ---- Top 3 genus–metric patterns per environmental variable ----
top3_by_metric <- genus_metric %>%
  group_by(EnvMetric) %>%
  arrange(desc(signal_score), desc(n_taxa), Genus) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("4c) Top 3 genus–metric patterns within EACH environmental metric\n")
cat("====================\n")
print(top3_by_metric %>% select(EnvMetric, Genus, n_taxa, n_pos_taxa, n_neg_taxa, prop_pos, dominant_dir, signal_score))

## ============================================================
## 5) Drill-down helper: list taxa driving a genus–metric pattern
## ============================================================

taxa_by_genus_metric <- function(genus, metric, n_show = 20){
  long_df %>%
    filter(Genus == genus, EnvMetric == metric) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(Effect))) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(Taxon, ": ", round(Effect, 3), ifelse(Effect > 0, " (+)", " (-)"))) %>%
    select(Taxon, Effect, Direction, label) %>%
    slice(1:n_show)
}

cat("\n\n====================\n")
cat("5) Taxa driving the TOP genus–metric association overall\n")
cat("====================\n")

if(nrow(top3_genus_metric_overall) > 0){
  g0 <- top3_genus_metric_overall$Genus[1]
  m0 <- top3_genus_metric_overall$EnvMetric[1]
  cat("\nTop genus–metric:", g0, "~", m0, "\n")
  print(taxa_by_genus_metric(g0, m0, n_show = 20))
}

cat("\n\nDone.\n")

```

```{r}
##Let's simply plot the correlation among metrics (METRIC UNITS, with FDR correction)
## assumes: alpha_diversity_meta, DeQueen.nutrient_metric

# -----------------------------------------------
# 1) Join alpha diversity metrics onto *metric* nutrients
# -----------------------------------------------
s_alpha.metric <- alpha_diversity_meta[, c("Sample","Observed","Shannon","InvSimpson","Faith_PD")]

nutr.metric <- DeQueen.nutrient_metric

# Harmonize "Sample" key in nutrient df to match alpha_diversity_meta$Sample
# NOTE: your prior chunk assumed Sample.Name matches the numeric suffix in "Sample_#".
# We keep the same logic here (no overwrite of existing objects).
if (!("Sample.ID" %in% names(nutr.metric))) {
  nutr.metric$Sample.ID <- paste0("Sample_", as.character(nutr.metric$Sample.Name))
}
nutr.metric$Sample <- nutr.metric$Sample.ID

# Merge (left join on alpha samples)
merged_df.metric <- merge(
  s_alpha.metric,
  nutr.metric,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------------------------
# 2) Build data frame: 4 metric-unit nutrients + moisture + ratio + 4 alpha metrics
#    (dry nutrient columns are still named *.dry, but they are now kg/metric ton)
# -----------------------------------------------
vars.metric <- c(
  "Nitrogen.dry", "Ammonium.N.dry", "Phosphorus.dry", "Potassium.dry",
  "Moisture", "NH4_to_TotalN",
  "Observed","Shannon","InvSimpson","Faith_PD"
)

vars.metric <- intersect(vars.metric, colnames(merged_df.metric))  # guard
E2.metric <- merged_df.metric[, vars.metric, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------------------------
# 3) Spearman correlation and p-values (raw)
# -----------------------------------------------
M2.metric <- suppressWarnings(cor(E2.metric, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

p_mat2.metric <- matrix(
  NA_real_, ncol = ncol(E2.metric), nrow = ncol(E2.metric),
  dimnames = list(colnames(E2.metric), colnames(E2.metric))
)

for (i in seq_len(ncol(E2.metric))) {
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(E2.metric))) {
    xi <- E2.metric[[i]]; yj <- E2.metric[[j]]
    ok <- is.finite(xi) & is.finite(yj)
    if (sum(ok) >= 3) {
      p_mat2.metric[i, j] <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(xi[ok], yj[ok], method = "spearman")$p.value)
    } else {
      p_mat2.metric[i, j] <- NA_real_
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------
# 4) Multiple-testing correction (BH/FDR) over unique pairs
# -----------------------------------------------
idx_upper.metric <- which(upper.tri(p_mat2.metric), arr.ind = TRUE)
p_upper.metric   <- p_mat2.metric[idx_upper.metric]

p_adj_upper.metric <- rep(NA_real_, length(p_upper.metric))
ok.metric <- is.finite(p_upper.metric)
p_adj_upper.metric[ok.metric] <- p.adjust(p_upper.metric[ok.metric], method = "BH")

p_adj2.metric <- matrix(
  NA_real_, nrow = nrow(p_mat2.metric), ncol = ncol(p_mat2.metric),
  dimnames = dimnames(p_mat2.metric)
)
p_adj2.metric[idx_upper.metric] <- p_adj_upper.metric
p_adj2.metric <- t(p_adj2.metric)
p_adj2.metric[idx_upper.metric] <- p_adj_upper.metric
diag(p_adj2.metric) <- NA_real_

# -----------------------------------------------
# 5) Pretty labels for the plot
# -----------------------------------------------
lab_map2.metric <- c(
  "Nitrogen.dry"    = "Total N (kg/MT)",
  "Ammonium.N.dry"  = "NH4+ (kg/MT)",
  "Phosphorus.dry"  = "P (kg/MT)",
  "Potassium.dry"   = "K (kg/MT)",
  "Moisture"        = "Moisture",
  "NH4_to_TotalN"   = "NH4+/Total N",
  "Observed"        = "Observed",
  "Shannon"         = "Shannon",
  "InvSimpson"      = "InvSimpson",
  "Faith_PD"        = "Faith's PD"
)

cn.metric <- colnames(M2.metric)
lab_ok.metric <- intersect(names(lab_map2.metric), cn.metric)
colnames(M2.metric)[match(lab_ok.metric, cn.metric)] <- lab_map2.metric[lab_ok.metric]
rownames(M2.metric)[match(lab_ok.metric, rownames(M2.metric))] <- lab_map2.metric[lab_ok.metric]

cnp.metric <- colnames(p_adj2.metric)
lab_ok_p.metric <- intersect(names(lab_map2.metric), cnp.metric)
colnames(p_adj2.metric)[match(lab_ok_p.metric, cnp.metric)] <- lab_map2.metric[lab_ok_p.metric]
rownames(p_adj2.metric)[match(lab_ok_p.metric, rownames(p_adj2.metric))] <- lab_map2.metric[lab_ok_p.metric]

# -----------------------------------------------
# 6) Corrplot using *adjusted* p-values
# -----------------------------------------------
stopifnot(identical(dimnames(M2.metric), dimnames(p_adj2.metric)))

png("correlation.metric.FDR.png", width = 6.5, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "transparent")

corrplot::corrplot(
  M2.metric,
  method      = "color",
  type        = "lower",
  diag        = FALSE,
  order       = "AOE",
  tl.col      = "black",
  tl.srt      = 45,
  col         = colorRampPalette(c("royalblue4","white","firebrick"))(200),

  p.mat       = p_adj2.metric,
  sig.level   = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05),
  insig       = "label_sig",
  pch.cex     = 0.9,
  pch.col     = "grey20",

  addgrid.col = "black",
  addCoef.col = NULL
)

dev.off()

cat("\nSpearman correlation matrix (metric nutrients + alpha diversity):\n")
print(round(M2.metric, 3))
cat("\nBH-adjusted p-value matrix:\n")
print(signif(p_adj2.metric, 3))

```

```{r}
##Better visualization (METRIC UNITS; ggplot lower-triangle heatmap)
## assumes you already ran the metric correlation chunk and have:
##   M2.metric, p_adj2.metric

# Build a tidy lower-triangle data frame (exclude diagonal)
cn.metric <- colnames(M2.metric)
rn.metric <- rownames(M2.metric)

df.metric <- expand.grid(x = cn.metric, y = rn.metric, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df.metric$i <- match(df.metric$y, rn.metric)
df.metric$j <- match(df.metric$x, cn.metric)
df.metric <- subset(df.metric, i > j)  # lower triangle only

# Pull rho and adj. p into the long frame
df.metric$rho <- M2.metric[cbind(df.metric$i, df.metric$j)]
df.metric$p   <- p_adj2.metric[cbind(df.metric$i, df.metric$j)]

# Significance stars (BH-adjusted p-values)
df.metric$stars <- ""
df.metric$stars[!is.na(df.metric$p) & df.metric$p < 0.05]  <- "*"
df.metric$stars[!is.na(df.metric$p) & df.metric$p < 0.01]  <- "**"
df.metric$stars[!is.na(df.metric$p) & df.metric$p < 0.001] <- "***"

# Factor levels for pretty matrix layout: x left→right, y top→bottom
df.metric$x <- factor(df.metric$x, levels = cn.metric)
df.metric$y <- factor(df.metric$y, levels = rev(rn.metric))  # reverse so origin is top-left

# Draw with ggplot (white tile borders, diverging fill by correlation)
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Please install ggplot2")

  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 3.6, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +

  ) +
  coord_fixed() +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +

    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

ggsave(
  "correlation.metric.FDR.ggplot.png",

  width = 4.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 900, bg = "transparent"
)

print(p_heat.metric)
```

```{r}
## Impacts on microbiome composition/beta diversity (METRIC environmental variables)
## Uses: physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric
## Notes:
##   - Same logic as DRY chunk, but swap in metric-unit nutrient columns.
##   - Permutations constrained within Position (strata), as before.

# -------------------------------
# 0) Data + distances (METRIC)
# -------------------------------
sample_data_df.metric <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric))
sample_data_df.metric$Position  <- factor(sample_data_df.metric$Position)
sample_data_df.metric$House     <- factor(sample_data_df.metric$House)
sample_data_df.metric$Growout   <- factor(sample_data_df.metric$Growout)
sample_data_df.metric$Treatment <- factor(sample_data_df.metric$Treatment)

bray_dist.metric     <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric, method = "bray")
wunifrac_dist.metric <- phyloseq::UniFrac(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric, weighted = TRUE,  normalized = TRUE)
uunifrac_dist.metric <- phyloseq::UniFrac(physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric, weighted = FALSE, normalized = TRUE)

n_permutations <- 9999

# -------------------------------
# 1) MAIN-EFFECTS model (METRIC)
#    -> order-invariant marginal tests for each covariate (by="margin")
# -------------------------------
form_metric_main <- ~ House + Growout + Treatment +
  Ammonium.N.dry + Nitrogen.dry + Phosphorus.dry + Potassium.dry + Moisture

permanova_bray_full.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_main, bray_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_bray_full.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_bray_full.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Bray-Curtis (main effects; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_bray_full.metric)

permanova_wunifrac_full.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_main, wunifrac_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_wunifrac_full.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_wunifrac_full.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Weighted UniFrac (main effects; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_wunifrac_full.metric)

permanova_uunifrac_full.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_main, uunifrac_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_uunifrac_full.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_uunifrac_full.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Unweighted UniFrac (main effects; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_uunifrac_full.metric)

# -------------------------------
# 2) INTERACTION model (METRIC)
#    -> adds Treatment:Growout (order-invariant test for interaction)
# -------------------------------
form_metric_int <- ~ House + Growout + Treatment +
  Ammonium.N.dry + Nitrogen.dry + Phosphorus.dry + Potassium.dry + Moisture +
  Treatment:Growout

permanova_bray_int.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_int, bray_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_bray_int.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_bray_int.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Bray-Curtis (interaction model; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_bray_int.metric)

permanova_wunifrac_int.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_int, wunifrac_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_wunifrac_int.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_wunifrac_int.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Weighted UniFrac (interaction model; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_wunifrac_int.metric)

permanova_uunifrac_int.metric <- vegan::adonis2(
  update(form_metric_int, uunifrac_dist.metric ~ .),
  data         = sample_data_df.metric,
  permutations = n_permutations,
  strata       = sample_data_df.metric$Position,
  by           = "margin"
)
permanova_uunifrac_int.metric$qval <- p.adjust(permanova_uunifrac_int.metric$`Pr(>F)`, "fdr")
cat("\n--- METRIC • Unweighted UniFrac (interaction model; by=margin) ---\n"); print(permanova_uunifrac_int.metric)

# -------------------------------
# 3) Extractor for tables (METRIC)
# -------------------------------
extract_permanova_terms.metric <- function(ad2_obj, distance_label) {
  df <- as.data.frame(ad2_obj, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$Covariate <- rownames(df)
  keep <- !grepl("Residual|Total|Model", df$Covariate, ignore.case = TRUE)
  df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  out <- data.frame(
    Covariate = df$Covariate,
    Distance  = distance_label,
    R2        = df[["R2"]],
    p.value   = df[["Pr(>F)"]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  ok <- is.finite(out$p.value)
  out$q.value <- NA_real_
  out$q.value[ok] <- p.adjust(out$p.value[ok], method = "BH")
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

permanova_terms_long.metric <- rbind(
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_bray_full.metric,     "Bray-Curtis"),
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_wunifrac_full.metric, "Weighted UniFrac"),
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_uunifrac_full.metric, "Unweighted UniFrac"),
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_bray_int.metric,      "Bray-Curtis"),
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_wunifrac_int.metric,  "Weighted UniFrac"),
  extract_permanova_terms.metric(permanova_uunifrac_int.metric,  "Unweighted UniFrac")
)

cov_order.metric <- c("House","Growout","Treatment",
                      "Treatment:Growout",
                      "Ammonium.N.dry","Nitrogen.dry","Phosphorus.dry","Potassium.dry","Moisture")

permanova_terms_long.metric$Covariate <- factor(
  permanova_terms_long.metric$Covariate,
  levels = intersect(cov_order.metric, unique(permanova_terms_long.metric$Covariate))
)

permanova_terms_long.metric <- permanova_terms_long.metric[
  order(permanova_terms_long.metric$Covariate, permanova_terms_long.metric$Distance),
]

cat("\n--- METRIC • Marginal terms (long) ---\n"); print(permanova_terms_long.metric)

```

```{r}
## ===============================
## PROTEST (metric): community vs env
## ===============================
## Assumes in workspace:
## - physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric
## - sample_data_df.metric (from your PERMANOVA metric chunk)
## - bray_dist.metric, wunifrac_dist.metric, uunifrac_dist.metric (dist objects)

## 1) Pick *metric-unit* environmental variables & standardize
env_vars_metric <- c("Nitrogen.dry","Ammonium.N.dry","Phosphorus.dry","Potassium.dry","Moisture")
env_vars_metric <- env_vars_metric[env_vars_metric %in% colnames(sample_data_df.metric)]
stopifnot(length(env_vars_metric) > 0)

env_raw.metric <- sample_data_df.metric[, env_vars_metric, drop = FALSE]

## Drop rows with any NA in env; PROTEST requires matched samples
keep_rows.metric <- stats::complete.cases(env_raw.metric)
env_std.metric   <- scale(env_raw.metric[keep_rows.metric, , drop = FALSE])  # center/scale
env_ids.metric   <- rownames(sample_data_df.metric)[keep_rows.metric]

cat("[PROTEST•metric] Variables:", paste(colnames(env_std.metric), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("[PROTEST•metric] Samples kept:", length(env_ids.metric), "\n")

## 2) Helper: subset a 'dist' to selected labels
subset_dist.metric <- function(d, keep) {
  m  <- as.matrix(d)
  m2 <- m[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
  stats::as.dist(m2)
}

## 3) Align each community distance to the env samples
bray_sub.metric     <- subset_dist.metric(bray_dist.metric,     env_ids.metric)
wunifrac_sub.metric <- subset_dist.metric(wunifrac_dist.metric, env_ids.metric)
uunifrac_sub.metric <- subset_dist.metric(uunifrac_dist.metric, env_ids.metric)

## 4) Environmental Euclidean distance (on standardized env)
env_dist.metric <- vegan::vegdist(env_std.metric, method = "euclidean")

## 5) Run PROTEST (9,999 perms) for each metric
set.seed(1)
protest_bray.metric     <- vegan::protest(X = bray_sub.metric,     Y = env_dist.metric, permutations = 9999)
protest_wunifrac.metric <- vegan::protest(X = wunifrac_sub.metric, Y = env_dist.metric, permutations = 9999)
protest_uunifrac.metric <- vegan::protest(X = uunifrac_sub.metric, Y = env_dist.metric, permutations = 9999)

## 6) Tidy summary (p-only as requested)
get_protest.metric <- function(obj, metric) {
  data.frame(
    Metric       = metric,
    Procrustes_r = as.numeric(obj$t0),
    p_value      = as.numeric(obj$signif),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

protest_summary.metric <- rbind(
  get_protest.metric(protest_bray.metric,     "Bray-Curtis"),
  get_protest.metric(protest_wunifrac.metric, "Weighted UniFrac"),
  get_protest.metric(protest_uunifrac.metric, "Unweighted UniFrac")
)

## 7) Print
cat("\n--- PROTEST (metric) summary ---\n")
print(
  protest_summary.metric |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Procrustes_r = round(Procrustes_r, 3),
      p_value      = signif(p_value, 3)
    )
)

```

```{r}
## ================================================================
## Per-variable comparisons across methods (NO re-running PERMANOVA)
## p-only pipeline • db-RDA replaces p-RDA • METRIC UNITS
## ================================================================

## ---- Assumptions already in your workspace (METRIC) -----------------------
## - env_std.metric, bray_sub.metric, wunifrac_sub.metric, uunifrac_sub.metric (aligned IDs)
## - sample_data_df.metric
## - physeq_no_growout3_css_nutr.metric
## - permanova_bray_full.metric, permanova_wunifrac_full.metric, permanova_uunifrac_full.metric
## Packages loaded: vegan, phyloseq, dplyr, tidyr

## ---- 0) METRIC variables of interest --------------------------------------
env_vars.metric <- c("Nitrogen.dry","Ammonium.N.dry","Phosphorus.dry","Potassium.dry","Moisture")
env_vars.metric <- env_vars.metric[env_vars.metric %in% colnames(sample_data_df.metric)]
stopifnot(length(env_vars.metric) > 0)

## Sanity: ensure aligned/standardized env + distances exist
stopifnot(exists("env_std.metric"), exists("bray_sub.metric"),
          exists("wunifrac_sub.metric"), exists("uunifrac_sub.metric"))

## Prepare the model frame (constraints/conditions) matching env_std.metric rows
keep_ids.metric <- rownames(env_std.metric)
dat.metric <- sample_data_df.metric[keep_ids.metric, , drop = FALSE]
dat.metric$House     <- factor(dat.metric$House)
dat.metric$Growout   <- factor(dat.metric$Growout)
dat.metric$Treatment <- factor(dat.metric$Treatment)
dat.metric$Position  <- factor(dat.metric$Position)

## ---- 1) Mantel (singletons): Spearman r per variable ----------------------
.per_var_mantel.metric <- function(comm_dist, env_std, perms = 9999L) {
  out <- lapply(colnames(env_std), function(v) {
    d <- dist(env_std[, v, drop = FALSE], method = "euclidean")
    fit <- vegan::mantel(comm_dist, d, method = "spearman", permutations = perms)
    data.frame(
      Variable = v,
      Effect   = unname(fit$statistic),  # Mantel Spearman r
      p_value  = unname(fit$signif),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

bioenv_single_bray.metric     <- .per_var_mantel.metric(bray_sub.metric,     env_std.metric)
bioenv_single_wunifrac.metric <- .per_var_mantel.metric(wunifrac_sub.metric, env_std.metric)
bioenv_single_uunifrac.metric <- .per_var_mantel.metric(uunifrac_sub.metric, env_std.metric)

bioenv_long.metric <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(bioenv_single_bray.metric,     Metric = "Bray-Curtis"),
  dplyr::mutate(bioenv_single_wunifrac.metric, Metric = "Weighted UniFrac"),
  dplyr::mutate(bioenv_single_uunifrac.metric, Metric = "Unweighted UniFrac")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Analysis = "BIO-ENV (singleton)",
    Stat     = "Spearman r"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(Variable %in% env_vars.metric)

## ---- 2) db-RDA (per distance): per-variable unique partial adj. R² --------
## For each distance metric, fit:
##   dbrda(D ~ var + Condition(House + Growout + Treatment + Position))
## Extract adj. R² (constrained fraction) and permutation p for the var.
.per_var_dbrda.metric <- function(comm_dist, metric_label, dat, env_vars, perms = 9999L) {
  res <- lapply(env_vars, function(v) {
    f  <- as.formula(paste("comm_dist ~", v, "+ Condition(House + Growout + Treatment + Position)"))
    mv <- vegan::dbrda(f, data = dat)  # LHS is a "dist" object
    a  <- vegan::anova.cca(mv, permutations = perms)
    p  <- tryCatch(a$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
    R2 <- vegan::RsquareAdj(mv)$adj.r.squared
    data.frame(
      Variable = v,
      Effect   = max(0, R2),   # partial adj. R² (non-negative)
      p_value  = p,
      Metric   = metric_label,
      Analysis = "db-RDA (partial)",
      Stat     = "partial adj. R²",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, res)
}

dbrda_bray_long.metric     <- .per_var_dbrda.metric(bray_sub.metric,     "Bray-Curtis",        dat.metric, env_vars.metric)
dbrda_wunifrac_long.metric <- .per_var_dbrda.metric(wunifrac_sub.metric, "Weighted UniFrac",   dat.metric, env_vars.metric)
dbrda_uunifrac_long.metric <- .per_var_dbrda.metric(uunifrac_sub.metric, "Unweighted UniFrac", dat.metric, env_vars.metric)

dbrda_long.metric <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dbrda_bray_long.metric,
  dbrda_wunifrac_long.metric,
  dbrda_uunifrac_long.metric
)

## ---- 3) PERMANOVA (by="margin"): extract env terms ONLY -------------------
extract_permanova_env.metric <- function(ad2_obj, metric_label, env_vars) {
  df <- as.data.frame(ad2_obj, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$Term <- rownames(df)
  df <- df[df$Term %in% env_vars, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  pcol <- grep("^Pr\\(>F\\)$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    Variable = df$Term,
    Effect   = df$R2,          # partial R²
    p_value  = df[[pcol]],
    Metric   = metric_label,
    Analysis = "PERMANOVA (margin)",
    Stat     = "partial R²",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

perm_env_long.metric <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_permanova_env.metric(permanova_bray_full.metric,     "Bray-Curtis",        env_vars.metric),
  extract_permanova_env.metric(permanova_wunifrac_full.metric, "Weighted UniFrac",   env_vars.metric),
  extract_permanova_env.metric(permanova_uunifrac_full.metric, "Unweighted UniFrac", env_vars.metric)
)

## ---- 4) Combine all results (p-only; db-RDA replaces p-RDA) ---------------
all_long_p_only.metric <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  bioenv_long.metric[,   c("Variable","Effect","p_value","Metric","Analysis","Stat")],
  perm_env_long.metric[, c("Variable","Effect","p_value","Metric","Analysis","Stat")],
  dbrda_long.metric[,    c("Variable","Effect","p_value","Metric","Analysis","Stat")]
)

## Order variables and facets
all_long_p_only.metric$Variable <- factor(all_long_p_only.metric$Variable, levels = env_vars.metric)
all_long_p_only.metric$Analysis <- factor(all_long_p_only.metric$Analysis,
                                         levels = c("BIO-ENV (singleton)", "PERMANOVA (margin)", "db-RDA (partial)"))
all_long_p_only.metric$Metric   <- factor(all_long_p_only.metric$Metric,
                                         levels = c("Bray-Curtis","Weighted UniFrac","Unweighted UniFrac"))

## Significance stars from raw p-values
all_long_p_only.metric$stars <- dplyr::case_when(
  is.finite(all_long_p_only.metric$p_value) & all_long_p_only.metric$p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  is.finite(all_long_p_only.metric$p_value) & all_long_p_only.metric$p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
  is.finite(all_long_p_only.metric$p_value) & all_long_p_only.metric$p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ ""
)

## ---- 5) (Optional) Tidy table print ---------------------------------------
print(
  all_long_p_only.metric |>
    dplyr::mutate(Effect = round(Effect, 3),
                  p_value = signif(p_value, 3)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Analysis, Metric, Variable)
)

## Resulting object for plotting downstream:
## - all_long_p_only.metric

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Facet label: "Analysis (Method)" with correct stat per analysis (METRIC)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_cols.metric <- c(
  "Mantel"     = "#2A788EFF",
  "PERMANOVA"  = "#d3436e",
  "db-RDA"     = "#000004"
)

# Start from the metric lollipop df you just built (from the prior chunk)
# viz_df.metric must already exist
viz_df.metric <- viz_df.metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = dplyr::case_when(
      Analysis == "Mantel"    ~ "Spearman r",
      Analysis == "PERMANOVA" ~ "partial R\u00B2",
      Analysis == "db-RDA"    ~ "partial adj. R\u00B2",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Stat)
    ),
    FacetLabel = paste0(Analysis, " (", Method, ")")
  )

facet_levels.metric <- c(
  "Mantel (Spearman r)",
  "PERMANOVA (partial R\u00B2)",
  "db-RDA (partial adj. R\u00B2)"
)
viz_df.metric$FacetLabel <- factor(viz_df.metric$FacetLabel, levels = facet_levels.metric)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lollipop plot (METRIC)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
p_methods_lollipop.metric <- ggplot(viz_df.metric, aes(y = Variable, x = Effect)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Effect, yend = Variable, color = Analysis),
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Base point (white), then colored outline, then significance fill on top
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3.6, stroke = 0, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Analysis),
             shape = 21, size = 3.6, stroke = 1.0, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Analysis, alpha = Significance),
             shape = 21, size = 3.6, stroke = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = analysis_cols.metric, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = analysis_cols.metric, guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("<0.05" = 1, "≥0.05" = 0),
    limits = c("<0.05", "≥0.05"),
    drop   = FALSE,
    name   = "Significance"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Metric ~ FacetLabel, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.text      = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x     = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y     = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  guides(
    alpha = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 5,
        stroke = 1.0,
        color  = "black",
        fill   = c("<0.05" = "black", "≥0.05" = "white"),
        alpha  = 1
      )
    )
  )

print(p_methods_lollipop.metric)

ggsave(
  "nutrient.lollipop.metric.png",
  p_methods_lollipop.metric,
  width = 7.5, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 900
)
```

```{r}
##New heatmap with all values

## Visualize results from: CPLM on CSS (ENV + COVARIATES) — METRIC
## All values shown, significant associations marked with asterisks

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

alpha_fdr.metric <- 0.05

# Path to the MaAsLin2 output (metric)
res_path.metric <- file.path("maaslin_env_covars_cplm_metric", "all_results.tsv")
if (!file.exists(res_path.metric)) {
  stop("File not found: ", res_path.metric,
       "\nMake sure the 'maaslin_env_covars_cplm_metric' run completed successfully.")
}

# Read the table
env_correlation.metric <- read.delim(
  res_path.metric,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Ensure numeric qval and coef
env_correlation.metric <- env_correlation.metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    qval = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qval)),
    coef = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coef))
  )

# Metric environmental variables
env_vars.metric <- c(
  "Moisture",
  "Nitrogen.dry",
  "Phosphorus.dry",
  "Potassium.dry",
  "Ammonium.N.dry"
)

# Keep all metric environmental associations, not only significant ones
env_correlation_env.metric <- env_correlation.metric %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(metadata),
    metadata %in% env_vars.metric,
    !is.na(qval),
    !is.na(coef)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_clean = stringr::str_squish(gsub("\\.", " ", feature)),
    significance = -log(qval) * sign(coef),
    sig_mark = dplyr::case_when(
      qval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      qval < 0.01  ~ "**",
      qval <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig = qval <= alpha_fdr.metric
  )

cat(
  "\nLoaded rows (metric):", nrow(env_correlation.metric),
  "\nMetric env associations retained:", nrow(env_correlation_env.metric),
  "\nSignificant metric env associations (q ≤ 0.05):",
  sum(env_correlation_env.metric$sig, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n"
)

# Keep features significant in at least one metric environmental association
features_to_plot.metric <- env_correlation_env.metric %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_clean) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(sig, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(any_sig)

plot_df.metric <- env_correlation_env.metric %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(features_to_plot.metric, by = "feature_clean")

# Rename metadata to plotting-friendly labels
rename_map.metric <- c(
  "Potassium.dry"   = "K",
  "Nitrogen.dry"    = "Total N",
  "Ammonium.N.dry"  = "NH4+",
  "Phosphorus.dry"  = "P",
  "Moisture"        = "Moisture"
)

plot_df.metric <- plot_df.metric %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata_plot = dplyr::recode(metadata, !!!rename_map.metric)
  )

# Column order
col_order.metric <- c("NH4+", "Total N", "P", "K", "Moisture")

# Build significance/value matrix
significance_mat_df.metric <- plot_df.metric %>%
  dplyr::select(feature_clean, metadata_plot, significance) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_clean, metadata_plot) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    significance = mean(significance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata_plot,
    values_from = significance,
    values_fill = NA_real_
  )

significance_mat.metric <- significance_mat_df.metric %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_clean") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Keep/reorder columns
col_keep.metric <- intersect(col_order.metric, colnames(significance_mat.metric))
significance_mat.metric <- significance_mat.metric[, col_keep.metric, drop = FALSE]

# Build asterisk matrix
sig_mark_mat_df.metric <- plot_df.metric %>%
  dplyr::select(feature_clean, metadata_plot, sig_mark) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_clean, metadata_plot) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_mark = dplyr::case_when(
      any(sig_mark == "***", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "***",
      any(sig_mark == "**",  na.rm = TRUE) ~ "**",
      any(sig_mark == "*",   na.rm = TRUE) ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata_plot,
    values_from = sig_mark,
    values_fill = ""
  )

sig_mark_mat.metric <- sig_mark_mat_df.metric %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_clean") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mark_mat.metric <- sig_mark_mat.metric[
  rownames(significance_mat.metric),
  colnames(significance_mat.metric),
  drop = FALSE
]

# Alphabetize rows and keep asterisks aligned
row_order.metric <- sort(rownames(significance_mat.metric), method = "radix")

significance_mat.metric <- significance_mat.metric[row_order.metric, , drop = FALSE]
sig_mark_mat.metric     <- sig_mark_mat.metric[row_order.metric, , drop = FALSE]

# Palette and legend
pal.metric <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-10, 0, 10),
  c("royalblue4", "white", "firebrick")
)

lgd_list.mas.metric <- list(
  title = "FDR",
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = "black",
  lwd = 1,
  direction = "horizontal",
  title_position = "topcenter",
  at = c(-10.1, -5, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 5, 10.1),
  labels = c("<-10", "-5", "-2.5", "0", "2.5", "5", ">10"),
  legend_width  = grid::unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_height = grid::unit(5, "cm"),
  x = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
  y = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2)
)

# Heatmap: all values, significant cells marked
ht.env.metric <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  significance_mat.metric,
  name = "FDR",
  na_col = "gray99",
  col = pal.metric,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = 8),
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 1),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  border_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = lgd_list.mas.metric,
  layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    marks <- sig_mark_mat.metric[cbind(i, j)]
    keep <- !is.na(marks) & marks != ""
    if (any(keep)) {
      grid::grid.text(
        marks[keep],
        x = x[keep],
        y = y[keep] - height[keep] * 0.25,
        gp = grid::gpar(
          col = "white",
          fontsize = 11,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    }
  }
)

png(
  "nutrient.heat.2.metric.all_values_with_asterisks.png",
  width = 3.2,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  res = 900,
  bg = "transparent"
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht.env.metric,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  padding = grid::unit(c(5, 7.5, 5, 0), "mm")
)

dev.off()
```
